items.jobTitle: Mechanical Systems Engineer - Landing Gear (all genders)
items.jobDescription:
Your Mission: 
 We are looking for a Mechanical Systems Engineer to help us develop and integrate the Landing Gear System of our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will take a leading role in defining, integrating and certifying the retractable landing gear system of a clean-sheet battery-electric aircraft, including extension/retraction actuation, wheels & brakes, tires, steering, anti-skid functions and associated indication sub-systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, prototype assembly support, ground & flight testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, avionics, and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.
   Your Day-to-Day: 
 Define and derive system-level requirements for the landing gear system based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations.
 Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.
 Contribute to the definition and development of the landing gear system to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.
 Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between the landing gear system and other aircraft systems and structures.
 Define system-level verification and validation strategies, including support for ground and flight test campaigns and qualification testing of landing gear equipment and assemblies.
 Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for landing gear system integration.
 Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.
 Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.
   Your Profile: 
 Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
 5+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft retractable landing gear systems.
 Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.
 Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.
 Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.
 Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.
 Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.
 Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems is a plus.
 Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme would be beneficial.
 Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for landing gear systems on CS-23 aircraft program is a plus.
 We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. 
   Why us? 
 Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.
 We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.
 Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.
 Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.
 Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.
 Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.
 Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.
 Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.
 Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.
 Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.
 Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

Your Mission: 
 As an Electrical Systems Designer, you will join the Vehicle Systems team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ Low-Voltage (LV) electrical and avionics systems. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the aircraft’s LV electrical and avionics systems, including LV EWIS routing and installation for all vehicle systems, guiding the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, wiring diagrams, and manufacturing drawings.
 You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.
 The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of LV electric systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.
   Your Day-to-Day: 
 Mature the LV electrical and avionics systems installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).
 Design and detail mechanical components for equipment and LV EWIS installation, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.
 Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies, electrical diagrams and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.
 Prepare and release electrical schematics, electrical diagrams, detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards.
 Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.
 Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.
 Perform technical assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.
 Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.
 Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration
 Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.
   Your Profile: 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.
 At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in a design role on an EASA/FAA Part 23/25 aircraft development program.
 Experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or international equivalent.
 Practical experience with the design and integration of aircraft electrical systems. Experience with electric aviation is an asset.
 Strong proficiency in CAD software, preferably CATIA V5/V6, including experience in part design, generative shape design, sheet metal design, assembly design, diagramming and drafting.
 Sound knowledge of aircraft electrical installations, aerospace materials, standard hardware and manufacturing methods, assembly and inspection requirements.
 Understanding of design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly principles.
 Ability to develop and assess installation designs while balancing manufacturing and maintainability considerations.
 Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach, attention to detail, and the ability to present clear rationale for solution proposals.
 A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.
 Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and the ability to work effectively in a multicultural team.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.
 Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.
 Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.
 But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.
 Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.
 Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.
 Your mission
 Build and maintain the Travel services that get seafarers onto the right flights, shipping well-tested features across our TypeScript stack as part of the Travel team. You'll start by taking pressure off the team by solving bugs, serving customer requests and leading investigations, and progress into owning Travel services of your own.
 ✈️ Keeping travel operations dependable / by resolving bugs and customer requests quickly and properly 
 Investigating and fixing bugs across the Travel services, reproducing each scenario before changing any code
 Handling day-to-day technical requests from customers and colleagues, and explaining what went wrong in plain terms
 Adding logging and metrics to what you build, and following runbooks when alerts fire
 🧭 Unlocking the product roadmap / by shipping well-defined features end to end 
 Building features across the frontend (React, Next.js) and backend (NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma) in Linear sprints
 Breaking work into clear steps, surfacing assumptions early, getting feedback on technical decisions and keeping progress and blockers visible
 Writing unit and integration tests, and acting on code review feedback
 📈 Building depth in a sensitive domain / by growing into ownership of Travel services 
 Learning how flight bookings, fares and travel aggregation work, and how they connect to crew changes
 Taking ownership of a Travel service module over time, including its uptime, bug rates and resolution times
 Sharing what you learn through clear pull request descriptions and team documentation
 You should have 
 Experience: early-career professional experience as a software engineer, building web applications across both frontend and backend.
 Experience: working knowledge of TypeScript and React, and some exposure to Node.js backends. Familiarity with any of Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma, Apollo Client, React Query, ShadCN, AWS (Lambda, SQS, RDS, ECS), Jest or Playwright is useful; we don't expect all of it.
 Experience: exposure to GDS systems (like Amadeus) or travel aggregator platforms is a plus.
 A high degree of ownership: you take a task from ticket to production and see it through.
 Sound engineering fundamentals: readable code, sensible tests, and systematic debugging.
 Technical depth and curiosity: you want to understand how the wider system works, not only the part in front of you.
 A genuine interest in travel and flight booking, and a willingness to learn the industry in depth.
 The ability to explain technical issues simply to customers and non-technical colleagues.
 Clear, proactive communication about progress, risks and blockers.

Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth 
 We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.
 Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.
 Today, we serve over 5 million clients, with more than €50 billion in assets under management - a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.
 The role 
 We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Graduate Trading Operations Analyst to join our Berlin team.
 You will help run and improve the operational processes that support our trading platform and the instruments available to customers. The role covers a broad range of topics - from investigating operational issues and supporting complex cases to understanding how processes, systems and data fit together.
 This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning how things work and finding better ways of working. We are looking for curiosity, sound judgment and the motivation to develop.
 What you’ll do 
 Execute and monitor essential daily and event-driven Trading Operations processes.
 Help manage the instruments available to customers in collaboration with Trading and Corporate Actions.
 Investigate operational discrepancies and identify their underlying causes.
 Support the development of reliable, efficient and scalable operational processes.
 Use data and appropriate digital tools to analyse issues and improve recurring activities.

 Develop the knowledge required to support complex instrument and trading-related queries.
 Contribute to team projects and wider operational improvements.

 Currently completing or recently completed an undergraduate degree. We welcome applicants from a broad range of academic backgrounds.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Curiosity about how trading processes, systems and data work together.
 The ability and motivation to learn unfamiliar concepts and tools quickly.
 Good attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
 Clear written and verbal communication skills.
 A proactive mindset and willingness to take responsibility.
 The ability to work effectively both independently and with others.
 Nice to have 
 An interest in financial markets, investing, instruments or financial technology.
 Exposure to data analysis, automation or technical tools through university, an internship, extracurricular activities or personal interest.
 Knowledge of SQL, Python, APIs or similar tools.
 German language skills at C1 level or above.
 What we offer 
 Challenges that will help you develop and realise your potential quickly.
 Meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to make an impact early in your career.
 The chance to improve services used by millions of investors.
 Smart, high-performing colleagues who share a common goal.

About Nabla 
 Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:
 Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.
 AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.
 Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.
 Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.
 The best of AI at the service of healthcare 
 Nabla’s phenomenal traction is the result of 3 years of diligent product development.
 Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.
 Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership.
 Engineering at Nabla 
 Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.
 Your team
 At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.
 As a Full-stack Engineer, you'll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.
 The technical challenges 
 Volumetry and efficiency: We handle more than 2.5 million medical encounters per month. Each one is automatically turned into a clinical note sent to the clinician's patient record system, saving thousands of hours of administrative work and giving healthcare professionals more time for their patients.
 Real-time audio transcription: capturing and streaming audio reliably, from in-person visits as well as video consultations, and turning it into transcripts with very low latency
 Resilience: keeping the product working on weak or unstable networks, with no data lost and no disruption to the clinician
 Healthcare integrations: building robust connections to the third-party medical systems clinicians already rely on.
 Complex AI services: designing and running multi-stage LLM pipelines and agentic workflows at scale, with the reliability and auditability a clinical setting requires
 These challenges come with demanding product requirement s:
 Zero friction: clinicians have no time to learn a new tool, so the product must be fast to set up, intuitive, and useful from the very first consultation
 Trust: what we generate goes into patient records, so quality and reliability are non-negotiable
 Works everywhere: web, desktop and mobile, in clinics, hospitals or remote consultations
 Your impact 
 Build and improve product features across web, desktop and mobile platforms
 Design and evolve the back-end APIs and services that power them
 Collaborate closely with Product, ML, and Design to take projects from idea to production
 Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to team best practices
 Learn from senior engineers and grow your skills across the stack
 Your DNA 
 Solid foundations in Computer Science
 4+ years of industry experience in full-stack engineering
 Proficient in React (strong Vue.js experience also considered)
 Proficient in at least one back-end language such as Java, Kotlin, Scala, C#/.NET, Go, or Rust. We use Kotlin internally, and it's fine if you haven't worked with it yet 
 Comfortable working with AI coding tools and agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, etc.), and keen to use AI in your day-to-day work
 Curious, eager to learn, and motivated to grow in a fast-moving team
 Care about code quality and maintainability
 Enjoy working in an international team where English is our primary language
 Our Stack 
 Frontend: TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Rust, Electron
 Backend: Kotlin / JVM, GraphQL, PostgreSQL
 ML & Infra: Python, PyTorch, Slurm, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes
 Where you'll be based 
 Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers)
 Remote policy: 2 days a week
 Possibility of working abroad remotely up to 2 weeks, once a year.
 Benefits 
 Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.
 Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:
 Stock ownership
 100% healthcare coverage
 Meal vouchers
 Public transportation costs covered at 50%
 Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT
 Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare
 Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time
 Life at Nabla 
 When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed. 
 We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off . We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.
 If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.
 Our Values at Nabla 
 Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.
 Every day is a new chance to excel 
 We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.
 Stay humble 
 There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.
 Feedback is a gift 
 We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.
 Committed to diversity 
 We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.
 Diversity & Inclusion 
 Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.
 As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.
 Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed
 There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link .
 Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

items.jobDescription:
Health can’t wait . 
 Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.
 Alan exists to end the wait.
 Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.
 So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.
 We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.
 Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.
 📈 Finance community at Alan 
 Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever-changing business.
 We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.
 We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.
 We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision-making processes and challenge the status quo.
 The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:
 Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing
 Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance
 Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking
 Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A
 ⭐️ The insurance controller role ⭐️ 
 Our insurance scope is growing fast: more complex reinsurance treaties, prévoyance (disability and death cover) moving in-house, new products and markets. At the same time, Finance is taking over the Solvency 2 balance sheet, which will be audited from 2028.
 We’re looking for a rigorous, ownership-driven insurance finance professional to own our prévoyance technical flows and the production of the Solvency 2 balance sheet. You’ll join the Financial Controlling team (within Financial Reporting) and act as the hub between Risk, Actuarial, Ops, Data and Strategy, as well as the main contact for our reinsurers and external auditors.
 You’ll know these numbers inside out: how they’re produced, what business reality they reflect, and how to defend them to auditors, the ACPR and the Board. You read the source texts yourself (accounting rules, Solvency 2 regulation, treaty clauses), form your own view, and know when to escalate.
 ⭐️ What you will do ⭐️
 Prévoyance flows: own premiums, claims, technical provisions (mathematical and claims reserves) and related reinsurance, from P&L through balance sheet and cash
 Reinsurance accounting: manage reinsurance accounts, quarterly settlements and profit-sharing clauses, making sure the books reflect what our treaties actually say
 Solvency 2 balance sheet (solo and group): restate French GAAP to Solvency 2, challenge actuarial best estimates and risk margin, and track own funds quarter to quarter
 Regulatory reporting: prepare balance sheet and own-funds QRTs and write the balance-sheet section of the SFCR
 Audit readiness: be the single point of contact for auditors on Solvency 2, starting with the 2027 dry run, with documentation and controls always ready

items.jobDescription:
About Scality
 Scality solves organisations' biggest data storage challenges: growth, security, performance, and cost. Designed for end-to-end cyber resilience, only Scality S3 object storage with CORE5 safeguards data at every level of the system, from API to architecture. Its patented MultiScale Architecture enables limitless, independent scalability in all critical dimensions to meet the unpredictable demands of modern workloads. The world's most discerning companies depend on Scality to accelerate high-performance AI initiatives, optimize cloud deployments, and defend their data with confidence. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality software is reliable, secure, and sustainable.
 The job context 
 The team
 Our IT & Security team builds, runs and secures Scality's IT infrastructure. It also supports the whole Scality community: employees, contractors, consultants and freelancers. We make sure everyone works in a secure, compliant and up-to-date environment. We also bring security expertise to our products (RING, ARTESCA, ADI) and to our customers.
 You will join a team of 4 to 5 people with varied backgrounds (development, security, IT operations, helpdesk) and 2 to 30+ years of experience.
 The mission
 You will own Scality's information security compliance program and coordinate the team's security operations. You will lead our ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 (AI management system) certifications and manage vulnerability (CVE) follow-up with Engineering. 
 You will answer customer security requests and audits. You will also help our products meet new regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
 The role is about 70% governance, risk and compliance (GRC) and product security, and 30% hands-on security operations.
 The job description 
 You will own (Responsible)
 Security operations coordination : be the point of contact for incoming IT & Security requests, prioritize them and dispatch them within the team.
 Vulnerability management : Assess product exposure to CVEs by leveraging internal tools powered by our Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs).. Handle customer security requests (RD tickets) with Engineering and Support until a fix version or a customer answer is delivered. Track scan and pentest reports through remediation.
 ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 programs : maintain the framework, policies and procedures in our GRC tool. Run risk analysis and treatment plans, objectives and indicators, and the Statement of Applicability. Prepare internal and external audits and follow up on nonconformities and improvement opportunities.
 Control management : run the monthly, quarterly and annual controls (account and access reviews across HR system and SSO, application access, offboarding checks), automate them in Jira and keep audit evidence.
 ISMS processes : run security incident management and change management in Jira (workflows, fields, records), and the business continuity part of customer requests (ISO 22301-type questionnaires).
 Third-party and application security reviews : assess new SaaS tools, suppliers and internal applications or automations (no-code tools, Slack or AI integrations). Keep the supplier inventory and the service account inventory up to date.
 AI governance : maintain the AI systems inventory, review the AI features of tools before use, and follow regulatory changes (EU AI Act).
 Personal data : maintain the personal data inventory and processing records (GDPR, CNIL guidance) together with the data protection contact.
 Customer trust : answer security questionnaires and RFPs, and prepare evidence packages for customer audits (banking, telecom and public-sector customers).
 Security awareness : plan and run awareness and phishing campaigns, and track participation and click rates for managers.
 You will contribute to (Contributor)
 Product security and certifications : prepare the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) technical files per product (compliance matrix, risk assessment, SBOM, vulnerability handling, RACI). Also contribute to CISA Secure by Design commitments and UK Cyber Essentials. Bring security input to the product roadmap, the development teams and the product documentation.
 Data leak prevention : define and tune DLP indicators and alerts (Google Workspace, Salesforce event monitoring) and investigate alerts.
 Infrastructure security : IaaS/PaaS security, monitoring and SIEM alerting, reporting of security incidents, business continuity and disaster recovery.
 Automation and tooling : scripts (Python, Bash) and Jira automations that reduce manual work.
 IT operations : account, application and permission management, level 1 and 2 network and security incidents.
 Mentoring : onboard and supervise interns or work-study students on security topics.
 You will be informed of
 Laptop fleet and IT room hardware, SSO integration and SaaS administration, level 3 network management, CI security, and relations with external IT providers. Other team members handle these topics.
 Desired profile 
 In general
 Degree in cybersecurity, information systems or equivalent experience
 2 to 5 years of experience in information security, GRC or security operations
 Based in France
 Technical skills
 Practical experience with ISO 27001 (2022): risk analysis, Statement of Applicability, controls, internal or certification audits
 Knowledge of risk methodologies (ISO 27005, EBIOS RM or similar)
 Understanding of vulnerability management: CVE, CVSS, SBOM, reading scan and pentest reports
 Basic knowledge of identity and access management (SSO, SAML/OIDC, MFA, access reviews)
 Ability to assess the security of a SaaS tool or an application: data flows, permissions, data retention, use of data for AI training
 Jira (workflows, automation) and spreadsheets for control tracking
 Python or Bash scripting for automation
 Clear writing for policies, procedures and answers to customers
 Bonus skills
 ISO 42001, EU AI Act or AI risk management (e.g. ISO 23894)
 EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, CISA Secure by Design, UK Cyber Essentials
 GDPR and personal data inventories
 DLP, SIEM, centralized logging and monitoring
 Linux, cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Terraform, Packer, SaltStack
 Experience in a software vendor and with enterprise customers' security audits
 Personal skills
 Organized and rigorous: you run many topics in parallel and follow each one to closure
 Autonomous and proactive: you follow up with other teams without waiting to be asked
 Good communicator, able to explain security requirements to non-experts and convince them
 Curious, eager to learn new norms and regulations as they come out
 Willing to share knowledge and guide interns
 Languages
 Fluent French (the team is based in France)
 Professional English: daily work with US teams; all policies, documentation and many customer questionnaires are in English
 Our tools 
 GRC platform (OverSecur), Jira and Confluence, OneLogin SSO, Google Workspace, Slack, Salesforce, BambooHR, phishing simulation and awareness platform, internal CVE/SBOM platform, Grafana, vSphere, Terraform, Packer, SaltStack, Python and Bash.

🍇 About grape:  
 Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first. 
 At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! 
 Your role
 Our data and tech give us an edge in risk assessment, pricing and premium calculation. This role turns that into accurate models that support our carrier partners and our growth, builds tuned models where they beat rules and off-the-shelf LLMs in claims (triage, intervention, return-to-work, fraud), and responsibly explores how data can help employees stay healthy through grape Care.
 We’re looking for an applied ML engineer / data scientist to build predictive models from the ground up on real, regulated insurance data. You’ll own problems end to end, from effective-dated records to production, in a domain where correctness and responsible use genuinely matter.
 Starting points include pricing and risk, portfolio monitoring, claims and payment patterns, triage and return-to-work, absence, and fraud detection. grape sits on a rich dataset, though, and you’ll help find the next high-value use cases. You’re candid about what the data can support, and you propose simpler approaches when they’re the right answer.
 This is not an LLM role. LLM and agent workflows and document extraction sit with our engineering teams, and you’ll use their outputs as features.
 What you'll do: 
 Build and validate models 
 Own the full model lifecycle: feature engineering, training, evaluation, explainability, deployment, and drift monitoring.
 Backtest on the historical book and run models in shadow mode alongside human decision-makers, reporting where and why they disagree.
 Produce audit-ready validation and governance documentation that actuarial, compliance, and carrier partners can review.
 Platform and MLOps 
 Deploy models on grape’s cloud platform within strict security and data-residency requirements for health data.
 Set up experiment tracking, model versioning, and production monitoring, partnering with engineering on integration.
 Shape the problem space 
 Identify and prioritize high-value use cases as you explore the dataset, rather than waiting to be handed problems.
 Turn ambiguous business questions into well-defined, measurable modelling.
 Responsible & explainable by design 
 Build privacy, fairness, and explainability into every model that touches personal or health data, working with compliance and legal on nDSG/GDPR boundaries.
 Models support decisions; accountable owners make them. Pricing, reserving, and claims work requires licensed-actuary sign-off, and any automation requires governance approval first.
 Collaborate 
 Explain model behavior and limits to underwriting, claims, actuarial, and compliance teams.
 What you'll need: 
 Strong applied ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, time-series, and survival/duration modeling.
 Proven experience building models on real-world, relational, effective-dated data, including imbalanced outcomes.
 Fluent Python (pandas, scikit-learn, a modern ML stack) and strong SQL.
 Solid grasp of validation, calibration, and explainability (e.g. SHAP).
 Production MLOps: experiment tracking, versioning, and drift monitoring.
 Sound judgment on data privacy and modelling.
 Fluent English.
 Bias for action, ownership, and clear cross-functional communication.
 Big plus: 
 Insurance, actuarial, or risk modeling (pricing, reserving, loss ratios).
 Health, disability, or absence data, especially Swiss insurance (KTG, UVG); fraud detection in claims.
 Regulated special-category data under nDSG/GDPR, or model risk management.
 Google Cloud, including security-restricted deployments.
 German language skills.
 🤝 What we offer in return: 
 🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions. 
 💻  Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office. 
 🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home. 
 🌐  Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office. 
 ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to. 
 🧠  Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually 
 ❤️‍🩹  Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy. 
 🎫  Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams. 
 ✈️   Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues. 
 🚂   Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office. 
 🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days. 
 🧖‍♀️  Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs. 
 👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life. 
 ✈️  Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review). 
 🏁 Our recruitment process 
 We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps: 
 Step 1 - Your motivation 
 To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team. 
 Step 2 - Role fit 
 In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager. 
 Step 3 - Case study 
 For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. This allows us to better evaluate your specific skills and problem-solving abilities. 
 Step 4 - Our culture connect 
 Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision. 
 Our diverse experiences, perspectives, and voices make us the company we are, and we would love to learn more about you! 
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 Health is our foundation. Innovation drives our mission. Together, we’re building the future of employee insurance. 
 At grape, collaboration isn’t just a buzzword, it’s the foundation of how we work, live, and succeed. From bold brainstorms and lessons learned, we overcome challenges side by side. Our time together is our greatest asset. Disrupting an industry that truly needs change takes courage, creativity, and team spirit and that’s exactly what defines us. 
 With well-being at the core, we foster an environment where ideas and people thrive. Your growth matters as much as our mission. Whether it’s supporting your self-care, developing new solutions, or redefining how health and insurance connect, we grow together. 
 Our values guide us every step of the way: keeping  Health at Heart ,  Invent ing  Together , and always striving to  Embrace Clarity . Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

About EH Energy Engineering 
 EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.
 To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.
 This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland . We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements , so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate .
   Key responsibilities 
 Certification strategy and project management 
 Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)
 Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work
 Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)
 Safety engineering and risk analysis 
 Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)
 Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing
 Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection
 Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports
 Compliance and technical documentation 
 Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports
 Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling
 Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards
 Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates
 Collaboration and continuous improvement 
 Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).
 Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)
 Standards and regulatory scope 
 The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required
 IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230
 Required qualifications 
 Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent
 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)
 Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110
 Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs
 Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard
 Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts
 Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508
 Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals
 Fluent English, written and spoken
 Preferred qualifications and personal profile 
 Nice to have 
 Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects
 Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED
 Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification
 Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification
 Personal profile 
 Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail
 Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving
 Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers
 Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end
 Start date: Immediately

Van slimme AI-modellen naar oplossingen die écht werken. 
 Een AI-model bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat het betrouwbaar draait, gekoppeld is aan echte data en waarde toevoegt bij een klant: daar wordt het interessant.
 Bij adesso werk je aan AI-oplossingen die verder gaan dan experimenten, van machine learning en MLOps tot generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bouwt, implementeert en verbetert oplossingen die organisaties echt gebruiken.
 Wat ga je doen? 
 Als Medior AI Engineer werk je samen met senior AI Engineers en Forward Deployed Engineers aan klantprojecten. Je pakt zelfstandig onderdelen op en groeit in architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid.
 AI ontwikkelen: je bouwt ML-modellen, LLM-toepassingen en agentic workflows.
 Van idee naar productie: je bouwt data- en ML-pipelines, automatiseert deployments en zorgt voor monitoring en betrouwbaarheid.
 Slim integreren: je koppelt AI aan bestaande systemen, API's en cloud- en dataplatformen.
 Meedenken met de klant: je vertaalt vraagstukken naar praktische, schaalbare oplossingen.
 Kennis delen: je legt herbruikbare patronen vast en deelt wat je leert met je collega's.
 Projecten die verder gaan dan het model 
 We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan:
 Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting.
 Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen.
 Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails.
 Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen.
 De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Je kiest steeds de techniek die bij het probleem past.
 Wat breng je mee? 
 Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van ML- of GenAI-oplossingen.
 Goede kennis van Python, SQL en machine learning.
 Ervaring met MLOps en/of LLM's, RAG en AI-agents.
 Kennis van minimaal één cloudplatform (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.
 Je werkt met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.
 Je denkt vanuit de klantvraag en legt technische keuzes helder uit.
 Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.
 Wat dit níet is 
 Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.
 Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt.
 Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past.
 Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt.
 Het team 
 Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. Jij gaat als AI Engineer de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.
 Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.
 Heb je diepe kennis van finance, retail of utilities en wil je dichter op de klant zitten? Kijk dan ook naar onze FDE-vacatures. Twijfel je? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen welke rol het best past.
 Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. 
 Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.
 We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.
 Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.
 AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk 
 We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.
 Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:
 Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.
 AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.
 adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.
 Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.
 En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen 
 Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit richting architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid.
 We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.
 Wat krijg je van ons? 
 €4.950–€6.050 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur
 8% vakantiegeld
 Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week
 Een mobiliteitsvergoeding bovenop je salaris
 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen
 €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen
 Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden
 Goede pensioenregeling
 Doorgroeimogelijkheden
 Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team
 Zullen we kennismaken? 
 Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.
 Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.
 Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

ABOUT US 
 Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.   
 At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 700 experts of 55 different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience.   
 Whether you're a tech enthusiast, payment expert, or a dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.   
 Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany and Luxembourg with a HQ in Berlin.

 You'll be part of the team responsible for the backbone of our e-commerce payment processing, building the services that move money safely and at scale. We care deeply about resilience, observability, and getting the hard details right, because in payments there's no room for "good enough."
 What your work will look like: 
 Design, build and ship features end to end for our AI products for the software development lifecycle, backed by solid tests and clear documentation.   
 Own key parts of how AI supports each lifecycle stage, from requirements and specification to coding, review, release and operations, and drive their delivery with the team.   
 Shape the architecture and technical direction of the AI-assisted development lifecycle through specs and design decisions.   
 Keep both products reliable, secure and trustworthy in production so teams can depend on them daily.   
 Continuously improve the codebase, tooling and processes, using the products themselves to raise the bar on how we build software.   
 What you need to be successful in this role: 
 A Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science (or equivalent practical experience) and 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience.   
 Strong programming skills in Java (or a comparable language), with experience building and maintaining production backend services.   
 Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic systems, such as tool calling, agent orchestration, prompt and context engineering, and evaluating agent output. A real curiosity about how AI can automate the software development lifecycle.   
 Comfort with AI native development in your own daily work, using coding agents and AI tooling to write, review and test code.   
 Solid experience with databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB, including data modeling and query performance.   
 Good understanding of modern engineering practices: Git workflows, CI/CD, code review and test automation. You know these processes well enough to help automate them.   
 Experience integrating APIs and working in service-based architectures.   
 Clear communication, a collaborative mindset, and the confidence to share ideas and contribute to technical decisions within the team.   
 Nice to have   
 Exposure to high-availability or high-volume systems, ideally in fintech or payments.   
 Experience with agent frameworks or protocols (e.g. MCP, LangGraph or similar), or with building internal developer tools.

 We will get back to you within 14 days of receiving your application.   
 The interview process includes a 30-minute intro call with a TA Partner, a 60- minute call with the hiring manager, 60min skills assessment and a 30min final call. Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability.

 More than a workplace. A place to grow. 🌍   
 At Unzer, colleagues from 50+ nationalities across four countries work together to create better outcomes for our merchants. We take ownership, move with pace and keep raising the bar—as one team.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams 
 The Embedded Automotive Platforms (EAP) group builds the software that connects Wayve’s AI Driver to the vehicle and its onboard systems. We develop the platform adaptation and integration layers that let our AI capabilities run reliably across different vehicles, hardware platforms and programmes.
 You’ll join a team working across Wayve’s internal fleets and customer programmes. Our work spans embedded software that resides between vehicle platforms, HMI and AI Driver, and the software interfaces that connect these capabilities to the AI Driver. We work closely with teams across autonomy, hardware, product and vehicle engineering to turn system requirements into robust, testable software.
 As a Staff Software engineer, you’ll own significant technical work from design through integration and validation. You’ll help shape how EAP software is structured, make sound engineering decisions in an evolving environment, and work with partner teams to deliver capabilities that operate reliably on real vehicles.
 🧠 Your day-to-day 
 Design, build and maintain embedded software that integrates Wayve’s AI Driver with vehicle platforms and onboard systems.
 Develop and evolve interfaces between AI capabilities, vehicle software and platform-specific components.
 Work across areas such as inference integration, vehicle data, navigation, localisation, odometry, driver interaction and motion control interfaces.
 Collaborate with engineers across autonomy, hardware, vehicle programmes and product to clarify requirements and resolve integration issues.
 Take features from technical design through implementation, testing, vehicle integration and release.
 Diagnose and resolve issues using simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, vehicle testing, logs and performance data.
 Contribute to architecture and engineering practices that support reuse across vehicle platforms and programmes.
 Use AI development tools where they can improve engineering productivity and software quality.
 🧩 What you’ll be working on 
 Building and integrating software for current and future vehicle platforms, including internal development fleets and customer programmes.
 Developing reliable interfaces and adaptation software between Wayve’s AI Driver and vehicle-specific systems.
 Improving software quality, observability, performance and resilience in resource-constrained onboard environments.
 Supporting the migration and evolution of capabilities across vehicle generations and hardware configurations.
 Working with simulation and test teams to improve how embedded and vehicle-integrated software is validated.
 Contributing to technical direction, reviewing designs and code, and helping raise engineering standards across the team.
 🙌 You should apply if 
 Essential: a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical, Automotive Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
 Essential: strong software engineering experience in modern C++, with a track record of delivering production-quality software.
 Essential: experience developing embedded or systems software, ideally on Nvidia and Qualcomm platforms with Linux/QNX.
 Essential: experience with Linux-based platforms.

 Desirable: familiarity with AV stack components like navigation, state estimation or driver-interaction systems.
 Desirable: experience with simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing or vehicle testing.
 Desirable: familiarity with automotive software development processes, including ASPICE or similar practices.
 Desirable: experience supporting software across multiple hardware platforms or vehicle programmes.

   More about Wayve: 
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth

Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.
Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. Our product is a data-driven platform that aggregates real-time feeds from across the commodities domain, transforming them into intuitive, actionable visualisations within one unified interface. We're looking for experienced data engineers who are familiar with these challenges at scale — people who understand what it takes to keep a data platform performing as complexity increases.
 We want people who thrive with ownership. At Sparta, you'll be handed problems, not solutions - and we expect you to run with them. Speed matters, autonomy is real, and we'd rather you move fast and course-correct than wait for permission. As a Staff engineer, you'll also be shaping the direction of the platform itself: engaging directly with stakeholders, contributing to product thinking, and investing meaningfully in the engineers around you.
 This role can be based in the UK (London) or Spain (Barcelona, Madrid), and we would expect to spend some time together with the team in-office (2 -3 days a week). 
 Core Responsibilities
 Play a leading role in the design, build, and ongoing evolution of scalable data pipelines and ETL frameworks that power both real-time and analytical data processing.

 Skills & Experience
 7+ years of experience as a data or software engineer, with a strong track record of delivering production-quality data systems.
 2+ years working within a product-focused organisation, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
 Proven experience building and scaling data-intensive pipelines and platforms in production environments.
 Deep understanding of stream and batch processing frameworks - hands-on experience with Flink or Spark is essential.
 Comfortable working across multiple programming languages - we primarily work with Kotlin, Python, and TypeScript.
 Equally comfortable designing high-level architecture as diving deep into low-level implementation details.
 Experienced in designing and deploying data infrastructure in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP.
 Hands-on experience with core data infrastructure tooling such as Kafka, Redis, and/or clustered Postgres.
 Nice to have experience
 Familiarity with open lakehouse technologies, such as Apache Iceberg and dbt.
 Experience building data infrastructure to support AI agents - including low-latency retrieval and analytical interfaces.
 Experience leading teams or managing engineers, driving both delivery and technical excellence.
 Exposure to complex distributed environments with demanding constraints such as high throughput, low latency, or large-scale datasets.
 Working style
 Whereas Sparta is a remote-first company, for this role we’re looking for someone who values a hybrid working style, which in a typical week could involve spending a couple of days in the office - with flexibility built in.
 Why Join Sparta?
 At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.
 • Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company
 • $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment
 • Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale
 • Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence
 • Top-tier tools and technology to support your success
 What's the Culture Like at Sparta?
 At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.
 The Sparta Code
 Understanding is non-negotiable 
 Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning. 
 The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.
 Ask for forgiveness, not for permission 
 Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not. 
 90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.
 Fall in love with the problem 
 The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to. 
 Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.
 It's your fault. Lucky you. 
 If it's on you, it's in your control. 
 True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.
 Conflict is a gift 
 Honesty is an expression of care. 
 Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

WHO WE ARE 
 Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
 Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
 Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.
 BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO 
 Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.
 Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware
 Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.
 YOUR IMPACT 
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance. Beyond the plant itself, you will help develop innovative grid-facing capabilities and online services, exploring new ways for power generation assets to create value through advanced connectivity, flexibility, and participation in the evolving energy ecosystem.
 WHAT YOU WILL DO 
 Define and develop the plant's electrical architecture, ensuring reliable and efficient operation across diverse electrical loads and systems.
 Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments.
 Specify and oversee the integration of electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and power conversion technologies.
 Establish monitoring, diagnostics, and condition-based maintenance approaches to improve asset reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.
 Develop predictive maintenance frameworks using operational and equipment health data.
 Evaluate and develop opportunities for advanced grid services, including flexibility, ancillary services, demand response, and other emerging market offerings.
 Explore innovative digital and online services that can enhance plant performance, operational visibility, and value creation within future energy systems.

 You are adaptable and motivated to grow with evolving technologies and increasing system complexity
 Experience in grid integration, or electrical infrastructure for industrial, utility-scale, or energy-related facilities is a plus
 Knowledge of reactive power compensation is a plus

Our mission is to enable world-class gaming experiences by delivering low-level, high-performance technology for PlayStation platforms.  
 The Role  
 We are looking for an engineer to join the GDFT department, working on the design and optimisation of PlayStation’s real-time game streaming technologies.  
 You will contribute to the development of low-latency video streaming systems across current and future PlayStation platforms, working on performance-critical areas spanning frame capture, media pipelines, codec configuration, system services and streaming transport.  
 The role is particularly suited to engineers with a strong C/C++ background and experience working with native video or media systems, including embedded devices, TV firmware, set-top boxes, consoles, or similar.  
 Our work sits at the intersection of product engineering and R&D.  Analyse existing media pipelines to identify unnecessary buffering, memory copies, synchronisation delays and other sources of latency.

 Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

 Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

 The role
 We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.
 You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.
 Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.
 Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time.  AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours.
